**Triage: `pm:queue`. No `domain:*`** — whole-repo seat; repo-local docs page, no `packages/spec` surface ⇒ no transfer.

**Premise re-verified against `origin/main` after #3537's PR (#3581) landed** — all three claims survive the merge that touched this very page:

```
content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx:59   ### Example Schemas
content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx:85   │   ├── schemas/             # Example schemas
content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx:221  // src/schemas/test.json
content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx:233  # Edit schemas in src/schemas/
content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx:264  ## Example Schemas
content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx:385  **Version:** 0.3.1
content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx:386  **Type:** Application (not published to npm)
content/docs/utilities/runner.mdx:444  Add to `src/schemas/`:
```

Note the surface is **wider than the body's three anchors**: `src/schemas/` recurs at `:221`, `:233`, `:444`, `:447`, `:466` as well. Whoever takes this should sweep the page for the ghost directory rather than fixing only `## Directory Structure`, or the page stays self-contradictory.

**Blocking collision is gone:** **#3537 is closed and its PR #3581 merged**, so the page is free. The tension the body records — the new "Metadata Loading" section says `src/app-data/` is user-supplied while the page above still advertises bundled example schemas — is now live on main and is precisely what this card resolves; the new section is authoritative.

**Dedupe** (three repos, issues + PRs): no duplicate. **#3576** (queued this same round) is the sibling card on `packages/runner/README.md` — different file, no overlap, but the two describe the same package and may sensibly be dispatched together by the lane. **#3533** is the same-root "documentation describes things that do not exist" family; **#3538** already removed the runner's non-existent env-var surface. On the `**Version:** 0.3.1` line the reporter's advice to delete rather than update is the right call — a hand-copied version behind a `fixed` changeset group (`@object-ui/runner` ships with 39 packages) drifts again on the next release.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。
